notes.title: Bug Fix Notice (2025.05.17)
notes.notes:
HELLO LUCKY HEROES
  
Thank you for your feedback. Based on your opinions and suggestions, we have fixed the following issues:

1. Dream Park
(1) Fixed an issue that could occasionally prevent minigames from being published in Dream Builder.

2. Online Party
(1) Fixed an issue where players could not cancel Star Party signups after finishing in an AnyTime AnyWhere match.
(2) Fixed an issue in the minigame Jump Rope where characters would be suspended in mid-air before the countdown began.

III. Esports 
(1) Fixed an issue where all participants were displayed as "Seed No.0" for a moment during tournament draws.
(2) An issue that caused avatars on the Tourney schedule interface to become blank has been fixed.

IV. Issues with Game Launch on Some Language Systems
There are currently issues with OS support for French, German, and Portuguese. We are actively working on a fix; in the meantime, you may switch your computer's format to English in Control Panel > Region > Format or wait for the hotfix. Please stay tuned to our community for updates.

Keep enjoying your time in Cube Planet! We will continue collecting feedback.
Your Loyal Dev Team: Thunderfire Universe X Studio (TUXS)

notes.title: Planet Party Time Steam First Technical Test Start Notice
notes.notes:
Dear heroes,

Our PC playtest on Steam will run for 5 days! We are very excited to have you join us. Please take a look at the details below:

I. Testing Schedule and Eligibility
✦ Testing Dates ✦
05/15 at 16:00 - 05/20 at 15: 59: 59 (UTC)
EDT: 05/15 at 12:00 - 05/20 at 11: 59: 59 (UTC-4)
PDT: 05/15 at 09:00 - 05/20 at 08: 59: 59 (UTC-7)

✦ Test Participation and Access ✦
Click "Request Access" on Steam to apply for access to the test.
Before the Test: The dev team will promptly grant testing eligibility to users in select regions. You'll be notified when your eligibility has been confirmed; then, you can preload the game and participate in the test.  
On the First Day: The dev team will promptly grant testing eligibility to users in select regions. You'll be notified when your eligibility has been confirmed; then, you can join the test immediately.
Starting on day 2 of the test, the dev team will approve a batch of applications daily at 15:00 UTC (11:00 EDT, 8:00 PDT). Please inform your friends who receive your Torchbearer Code to click "Request Access".

✦Controllers✦
You can use a mouse (we strongly recommend using the right mouse button for drag-and-move; it may take some time to get used to), as well as Xbox and PlayStation controllers.
Our game is still being optimized, and we welcome your feedback on controller support! We’re committed to improving the game and offer a better gaming experience.

II. Test Content
✦ A Therapeutic "Life Sim" Experience: Cultivate and Beautify Your Planet ✦
 Cultivate and plant, fish and mine, beautify and dress up, and create a personalized planet, experiencing a leisurely and therapeutic intergalactic idyllic life. In this test, we have prepared exclusive plotlines for the technical test that will help you gradually unlock the planet's story:
Time to start farming!
Join the Interstellar Trade Network!
Residents need some entertainment too!
Residents need delicious food too!
Residents also need refreshing drinks!

✦ 40+ Residents with Interactive Stories and Plotlines✦
Interact with over 40 residents, help them settle and live on your planet, fulfill their wishes, and earn their friendship.

✦120+ Multiplayer Party Minigames✦
Grab your friends or meet new ones in-game! Enjoy over 120 fun party games that rotate daily, along with tournaments that everyone can participate in.

✦Level Editor✦
A built-in editor that features racing, puzzle, and other game modes, allowing players to create and publish their works to share with others. We will also host related events in the official Discord.

✦Highly Customizable Character✦
Use an exquisite model with over 100,000 hairs, completely customizable with clothing and accessories, to create a Dino all your own. We will send out in-game currency each day so that you can purchase new cosmetics!

III. Test Event and Rewards
✦Exclusive Limited-edition Rewards for the First-time Testers✦
After this test ends, qualifying players will receive the limited-edition rewards permanently which will be activated when the game officially launches.
Log in for 3 days during the test to get a limited-edition T-shirt and a pair of limited-edition shoes in the game.
Log in for 4 days during the test of the test to get 2 limited-edition gold hats in the game, themed with American and Japanese styles.
Log in on all 5 days of the test to get an exclusive set of gold sunglasses and an exclusive starship!

✦Participate in the Game Testing and Share in Rewards Worth 2,000 USD✦
We will provide 100 Amazon Gift Cards for the test, each valued at 20 USD. Follow our Discord community to learn about the activity details.
Each user will receive only 1 Amazon Gift Card. The rewards will be distributed through the in-game mailbox during the 24 hours on the final testing day. Please remember to check your mail in-game.
Only test players who have accumulated at least 3 days of game login (including the final 24 hours) will be eligible to receive rewards.

✦Dev Team livestream marathon✦
We will be running a 120-hour dev marathon stream. Come explore the Cube Galaxy with us, and talk to the devs face-to-face!
There will be 18 hours of English livestreaming and 6 hours of Japanese livestreaming each day.

✦ Participate in Community Events for a Chance to win Surprise Rewards ✦  
We will hold a prize draw event in our Discord community during the last 24 hours of the test, with additional Amazon gift cards up for grabs. 

IV. More Info
✦Join our official Community✦
Welcome, lucky heroes, to join our official community and participate in the player events!
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/ppt/ ]https://discord.com/invite/ppt/ [/url]

✦ Follow Our Official Social Accounts ✦  
To stay updated on more game information, please follow us:  
X: [url=https://x.com/PlanetPartyTime/]https://x.com/PlanetPartyTime/[/url]
YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@PlanetPartyTime/]https://www.youtube.com/@PlanetPartyTime/[/url]
INS: [url=https://www.instagram.com/planetpartytime/]https://www.instagram.com/planetpartytime/[/url]
TikTok: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@pptgame]https://www.tiktok.com/@pptgame[/url]

✦ If You Encounter Serious Bugs ✦  
If you come across any serious bugs, especially those related to login issues, please email our dev team's support address so we can address and document them promptly: pptgame@service.netease.com

✦ Create Together with the Development Team ✦  
If you enjoy our game and want to help us create new planets, you can join our co-creation community and be among the first to collaborate with us on videos and UGC maps!  
Please send your relevant materials to: planetpartytime@service.netease.com

Have fun!

Your loyal dev team: ThunderFire Universe X Studio (TUXS)

notes.title: Planet Party Time First Gameplay Test Announcement
notes.notes:
Planet Party Time is opening a First Gameplay Test starting in May. In the First Gameplay Test, players will have access to the unique sim & party gameplay experience.

If you yearn to role-play as a fluffy companion among the planets and build your own world, be sure to sign up from Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384570/]Planet Party Time Stream Store Page[/url]

[b][h1]Test Period[/h1][/b]
The First Gameplay Test will start on May 15th PT & ET | May 16th JST and continues until May 19th PT & ET | May 20th JST. 

[h1][b]Where can I play the First Gameplay Test[/b][/h1]
The First Gameplay Test will be available on PC via Steam.
Planet Party Time welcomes everyone to join!

[h1][b]How to Join[/b][/h1]
The store page is now live! Visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384570/]Planet Party Time Steam Store Page[/url] and add to your wishlist and register for First Gameplay Test. You'll receive a notification when the test begins starting on May 15th, the game will be available for download.

[h1][b]Will progress be reset after test end[/b][/h1]
After the First Gameplay Test ends on May 19th PT & ET | May 20th JST, the progress from the First Gameplay Test will be reset.

[h1][b]What content I can expect?[/b][/h1]
Experience the completed game content, including the social simulation game and a powerful level editor.

For more information about Planet Party Time, check out and follow our official social channels.
